title.narrative: Scaling Up the Tiko Ecosystem for Youth Health and Employability in Ethiopia

description.narrative: The Tiko platform will aggregate service provision partners, demand creation channels, and product stockiest to cost-effectively generate and meet SRH demand. The Tiko system will use Tiko Miles; virtual reward points, to reward positive behaviors like initial choice, consistent use, and continued participation. 1 - Tiko Pro: Aggregating Demand Creation and Catalyzing Income Generation Tiko Pro provides community mobilisers, peer educators, and entrepreneurs with a platform to manage their businesses and generate income. By leveraging partnerships with stockiest, retailers, and providers, Tiko Pro allows entrepreneurs to earn through referrals, product sales, and basic service provision. In this project, Tiko Pros will refer adolescents for SRH services during outreach sessions. They will also sell fast-moving products - including menstrual hygiene management products - which provide less stigmatizing entry points to taboo SRH conversations. 2 - Tiko Explore: Accessible, destigmatized SRH Choice Service providers will provide free SRH services as part of Tiko Explore, Triggerise membership program, which positions SRH in the context of a broader lifestyle brand. Tiko Explore provides adolescent girls and young women with the opportunity to access lifestyle deals across five categories: living well,, earning, learning, saving, and looking good. Since the fundamental insight behind Tiko Explore is to provide benefits beyond SRH - to build relevance among adolescents - Tiko Explore will include SRH offers as well as broader lifestyle offers. Already established partnerships with FGAE, MSIE and PSI facilities will provide our target (15-24-year-old adolescent girls and young women) with access to free and discounted contraceptives and other SRH products and services. We will also explore partnerships with other private and public facilities, pharmacies, and direct-to-consumer channels. Service provider partners and other technical experts will be responsible for key SRHR messaging that we include during Tiko Pro outreach sessions, provider consultations, and in marketing materials. We will partner with retailers and organizations who will provide lifestyle offers that broaden Tiko Explore beyond SRH.
To ensure that young women 15-24 access and continually utilize SRH products and services that meet their needs whilst respecting freedom of choice.
Triggerise will primarily target low or no-income young women 15-24 in Addis Ababa and Bahir Dar who primarily live in informal settlements and are in the bottom quintile of wealth.

organisation.narrative: Triggerise is responsible for Implementing the Tikosystem to increase use of sexual and reproductive health (SRH) services amongst 15- to 24-year-old adolescent girls and young women

department.narrative: The Department is responsible for the scaling up of the Tikosystem, aggregation of service providers, and linking adolescent girls and young women to SRH products and services.

recipient-country.narrative: This activity is set to operate in Addis Ababa, the capital city of Ethiopia. It is expected to cover 6 sub-cities in the first year, and 8 sub-cities in the second year.

name.narrative: The implementation of the project is in Addis Ababa and Bahir dar.

sector.narrative: Our platform allows young adolescents age 125-24 to be informed about the choices they have and where they can access contraception choices. The platform provides a membership program which enables the girl to have access to free and discounted family planning services along with a reward that allows her to unlock many offers in the Tikosystem.
